dlentry.dd: A setting that disables the user-specific memory store, which contains rules saved by the AI engine for the current user. It is enabled by default.

A text area containing the set of rules saved by the AI engine for the current user. The text area is fully editable. All rules in this text area are collected and used with the Context whenever an AI action is invoked or when you chat with the AI engine. You can also ask the AI in the chat to forget a rule or to change its wording, and it updates the rule in this text area.
